international.title: Ukraine allies warn ‘Yalta format’ will not bring about peace – Europe live
international.summary: Berlin meeting of the ‘coalition of the willing’ comes after Trump declared Putin a ‘friend’ during trilateral meeting with Xi in China For what it’s worth, the China-US-Russia ‘peace declaration’ issued after their meeting, and published by Chinese state media , includes absolutely no mention of Ukraine or Europe whatsoever. There is only one, rather generic, line that could be seen as close to these issues: “The three heads of state exchanged in-depth views on the current international situation and pledged to maintain strategic stability and international security.” Continue reading...
